tips: Always use Urdu script for titles instead of Roman Urdu: 'Canada vs Australia' in Urdu script hit 6,000+ views (x10.16) while the Roman Urdu version flopped at 31 views (x0.18).
Completely stop food guides and niche cuisine topics: 'pk_food' is the worst performing series (avg 0.32x, Morocco food had only 4 views).
Produce more long-form country documentaries and city realities: 'pk_country' (Malta x4.24) and 'pk_city' (Seoul x1.27) strongly outperform page averages.
For Shorts, focus strictly on dramatic country comparisons and fast visual tours/mind-blowing facts (China facts x11.43, Singapore 60s tour x3.82).
Avoid short salary and living cost breakdowns: 'pk_salary_short' and 'pk_cost_short' consistently score low (Kuwait 94 views, Sweden 46 views, both under 0.25x).
